```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America must never again be left vulnerable to a global pandemic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe they must follow the informed advice of scientists and public health experts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take steps to protect federal scientists from political influence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will act swiftly to stand up a comprehensive, national public health surveillance program for COVID-19 and future infectious diseases.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will recruit at least 100,000 contact tracers with support from trusted local organizations in the communities most at risk to help state and local health departments use culturally competent approaches to identify people at risk of contracting or spreading the coronavirus.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe they must reverse decades of underinvestment in America's public health infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will substantially increase funding for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will substantially increase funding for state and local public health departments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"State and local public health departments suffered deep budget cuts during the Great Recession.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"State and local public health departments are at risk of further cuts as a result of President Trump's recession.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"State and local public health departments should be given sufficient resources to address pandemic diseases and other public health crises through coordinated efforts that are inclusive of underrepresented groups who may be disproportionately impacted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support medical and public health research grants for Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and other Minority-Serving Institutions (MSIs), which are particularly well suited to research health disparities in the context of COVID-19.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
